source.locator: Philosophy of Science 10 for the 1943 paper; Wiener locator unverified

sense.en: Purposeful behaviour is behaviour directed to a goal and corrected by negative feedback from its distance to the goal. Teleology is thereby made a matter of mechanism, the same in animal and machine: the founding move of cybernetics.

reading.en: The account keeps the loop, with exact laws of opposing exchange, and takes back what it was to explain. A target is any condition on the configuration, and how it forms is not modelled. A loop does not mark what regulates for itself: 04 reads a thermostat as having one too. A regulator at its set point protects nothing beyond it by that feedback. No account of purpose is offered in its place; 05 §12 lists purposes as not modelled. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance at the condition). The bound on the joint exchange is exactly no overshoot; within it, opposing, the level settles at m; beyond it an opposing exchange crosses and can oscillate for ever.

Theorem (any type; a determined law for rest). A target is any condition on the configuration; how it forms is not modelled. Under a determined law the orbit comes to rest with its target met exactly where it reaches a state the law leaves unchanged that meets it.

Reading [AI, new]. What tells the member rebuilt from the level from a thermostat, whose reader is given, and from a reader made from outside, is not a loop. Both have loops. It is that its stock buys it time and that its end does not come back.

Formations each holding a set point, their losses together above what the rest gives a gated condition, end it however small each one's loss. What protects what lies beyond at the set point is the choice among equal optima, which no law here models.

account_adds.en: Exact conditions for rest with a target met, and that holding a set point can end what lies beyond it.

source_adds.en: Teleology explained by feedback, across animal and machine; Wiener's information and control as one science. A target's forming is not modelled here.

name.en: Any determinate system organizes itself, and "good" is relative

source.work: W. Ross Ashby, Principles of the Self-Organizing System (1962)

sense.en: A determinate dynamic system goes to equilibrium, so it selects its own attractor with no outside selector, and in this sense any such system self-organizes. No organization is good in an absolute sense, only relative to a given environment. Paraphrased from memory.

reading.en: The basin law conditions the first half: within finitely many listed configurations every course enters what returns and each basin holds one cycle, an equilibrium being only its shortest case, with no selector; where no list holds the configurations a course can be drawn and never return (counting on draws 0 and merges nothing). So 'goes to equilibrium' holds within a list, and to a cycle. The second half meets 02's refusal to rank regions and 05's reading that attraction is not continuation. Parts adapted to the rest as organisms go past these laws. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type). Under any determined law courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; within m listed configurations every course enters what returns before step m and each basin holds one cycle.
Theorem (any process). Every process necessarily draws exactly what does not return. Runs are infinite, so a dead end is drawn vacuously: the law does not say a course entering the region exists.
Reading [AI, D65]. Attraction is not continuation: a selection absorbing perturbations can still erode its support.
Not shown: that generation is better than keeping or degeneration: order needs C, whose losses count needs the continuation condition. That passing, a reserve or a regulated level is good.

account_adds.en: The branching case, where being drawn and returning part; that an attractor need not be a continuation.

source_adds.en: The claim that such systems develop parts adapted to the rest of the system, read as organisms; a general theory of self-organization by this route.

name.en: Limits to growth, and overshoot through delay

source.work: Meadows, Meadows, Randers and Behrens, The Limits to Growth (1972); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990), appendix on archetypes
source.locator: Senge appendix 2, Limits to Growth; 1972 report locator unverified

sense.en: A reinforcing process of growth meets a balancing process as a limit nears, and slows or reverses. For the 1972 report, exponential growth in a finite world, with delays in feedback, overshoots and collapses unless the structure changes. Senge's advice: do not push growth; find and remove the limiting factor.

reading.en: 05 says joint excess restates overshoot in near-definitional arithmetic, naming this report; its record says it treats neither reserves nor delayed renewal, so the delay that makes World3's overshoot is not in the law. A rising take ends within B + 1 steps, the rise supplied; more without end needs renewers with no eventual bound; a reserve defers an end unless support returns. No curve, no collapse's shape, no limiting factor. [AI reading]

says.en: It restates the tragedy of the commons and overshoot (Lloyd 1833; Hardin 1968; Meadows and others 1972) in near-definitional arithmetic, not who ought to take less. Its record: stated for natural-number amounts; excess compares totals at each step and treats neither reserves nor delayed renewal.

Theorem (World). A take more than now at every step, from a condition given at most B a step, exceeds what is given after B + 1 steps: the seeker ends where it does not resume. A full taker whose take does not rise continues. The rise is supplied, not derived.

Theorem (World). Read more as: for every number, from some step on at least that many formations take at every step. Under balance, more without end needs replenishment with no eventual bound and, each giving at most a fixed amount, renewers with no eventual bound. Yields no "more is better".

Theorem (World). A formation unsupported from some step on is active over any later stretch at most as often as its reserve. A reserve defers the end, which still comes; bridging to returning support, it can carry activity without end.

account_adds.en: An exact end step under stated premises; that the premises are near-definitional; that more takers need renewers with no eventual bound.

source_adds.en: Overshoot through delayed feedback, World3's scenarios and collapse's shape; the limiting factor as what to look for. The live "restates" holds of the arithmetic and not of the delay.

name.en: Structure generates behaviour

source.work: Jay W. Forrester, Industrial Dynamics (1961); Donella H. Meadows, Thinking in Systems (2008); Peter Senge, The Fifth Discipline (1990)
source.locator: Meadows chapter 1; Senge chapter 3, the beer game; Forrester locator unverified

sense.en: A system's behaviour over time comes mainly from its own feedback structure, not from outside events, which only trigger it. Different people in the same structure produce similar results, so lasting change comes by changing structure. The central claim of system dynamics.

reading.en: The laws give it where a law is determined: the counterfactual of an act is the course the law generates, and "the lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours". But the same law runs either way from its start, on either side of a critical mass; which law the rest follows is supplied; and where a move has situations reaching two configurations, no law from configuration and move alone is right on both. So structure alone is scoped. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World; balance; the law of exchange supplied). Where the rest follows one law of exchange reading what has stood, two balanced flows with the same formations present, starting alike, in which the part acts alike, have the same levels and exchange at every step: the counterfactual of an act is the course the law generates. Which law the rest follows is supplied.

Theorem (any type). Only a change of the law, of how the rule reads or of the selection leaves where the reading favours at every share. "The lock belongs to how the rule reads, not the share it favours." That actual rules read the share is the premise.

Theorem (counts). With lo ≤ hi, under every schedule of reading, every course is locked one way at every step, which way set by the start: one law, two fates either side of a critical mass. Premises: readers drawn from those selected; constants; no noise.
Theorem (any type). Where a step by a move has situations reaching two configurations, no law giving the next configuration from the configuration and the move alone is right on both.

account_adds.en: Exact cases where a law fixes a course, and what the premise then moves to: which law, and which start.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim about social systems, as in the beer game, that different people reproduce the same pattern; and stocks, flows and loops as the unit of a structure, which the account does not take.

changes.why: capture: The archetype says winners eventually take all, stated generally of the structure. The targets condition it: ReadsShare is the premise, there is no noise, drift leaves either lock, and full taking excludes only under 05's premises. Its siblings cx-wamo-matthew-externality and cx-sspiral-winner-justifies-all are scope. cx-kpso-compounding-axis keeps agreement only because its source conditions itself on increasing returns.

dynamics: The sense states oscillation as what a lagging corrective loop does; Regulation.relay_threshold conditions it exactly, so scope, as cx-greek-aristotle-mean and cx-syscyb-trap-policy-resistance have the same law; 'the cycles present are witnesses' dropped held_oscillates. The item's summary lists 'delayed correction' as agreement and needs updating.

dynamics: Its 'cycles are witnesses, with no law of when or with what period' copies plan 4.1's line, which is false: Law.basin_one_cycle, Withholding.withholding_returns and Regulation.held_oscillates stand; only a regime's onset and period are absent (02's where-a-run row, mengzi's entry). Label unchanged.
competition: Its divergence (no law of self-governing restraint; the lab findings unread) is not cx-econ-ostrom-commons's agreement on boundaries.
couplings: It is cited for 'how a target forms is not modelled', which is why no account of purpose is offered. The loop itself rests on two-sided-regulation and the set-point optimum.

dynamics: Ashby states it of any determinate system; Law.basin_one_cycle holds within m listed configurations and gives a cycle, and 02 separates an open world. cx-syscyb-eigenforms reads the same law onto 'settles, whatever the start' as scope; fresh-reading with agreement of law was also contradictory by BRIEF. The item's summary lists 'Ashby's recursion into basins' as agreement and needs updating.

live_flags.what: §5 says "No institution is modelled on the spine", while 05 §12 gives a minimal model of one kind of institution (a-rule-rebuilt-from-the-members-it-limits, root). The sentence looks stale, or means more by institution than it says.

The AI reading says what keeps a commons is a coupling into it or a lowered capacity, "the means Ostrom (1990) found communities use". Her rules, monitoring and chosen sanctions are wider than that; a reader would take the narrow form for her finding. From my memory of Ostrom, not a checked text.
